title: A tab slider that follows your finger
summary: The bottom highlight now follows your drag and settles on the adjacent tab in the same direction.
changes: The selected bottom highlight tracks a horizontal drag over the bar or noninteractive Night, Changes and Breaks content; short drags spring back.
Swipe right to the tab on the right and left to the tab on the left. From Night, swipe right for Changes.
Vertical scrolling, forms, dialogs, Chat conversations and screen-edge gestures keep their existing behavior; reduced-motion settings remove the spring.
Roster calculations, Supabase data and PWA updates remain unchanged.
